item.title: States demand power to stop drones delivering drugs, weapons into prisons
item.summary: State AGs say federal legal uncertainty leaves corrections officials able to detect drones but powerless to stop contraband deliveries in real time.

item.title: GOP lawmaker draws line on Iran ground war as Pentagon weighs options
item.summary: Rep. Tim Burchett says there's no will among Republicans or Democrats for a ground conflict with Iran, urging Middle East partners to lead any land war.

item.title: Iran's internet blackout hiding strike damage and suppressing dissent, Israeli officials say
item.summary: Israeli officials say Iran's internet blackout is hiding war damage, jamming Starlink, and stopping civilians from organizing amid mounting regime pressure.

item.title: Trump admin launches Gen Z hiring push as officials warn of federal youth gap
item.summary: The Trump administration is launching a new effort to “make government cool again" by hiring Gen Z employees to rebuild the pipeline of talent entering the federal workforce.

item.title: New AI coalition targets Washington, Big Tech as group warns child safety risks outpacing safeguards
item.summary: The Alliance for a Better Future launches with an eight-figure budget to push AI regulation, saying policymakers must prioritize kids and workers over Big Tech.

item.title: Sophie Turner's 'Tomb Raider' injury brings production to a screeching halt
item.summary: Sophie Turner suffered an on-set injury, prompting the studio to pause production on the live-action "Tomb Raider" series, an Amazon MGM Studios rep confirmed.

item.title: FBI warns of zoning permit scam emails
item.summary: The FBI warns scammers are sending fake zoning and permit fee emails to homeowners, builders and businesses using real property details.

item.title: Israel Defense Forces suspends battalion from deployment over ‘inappropriate’ incident with CNN crew
item.summary: The Israel Defense Force (IDF) suspended an entire battalion from West Bank operations on Monday after soldiers allegedly assaulted a CNN crew.

item.title: Teen girl gunned down in posh Chicago enclave as police rush to nab her killer
item.summary: Lilly Bova, a 16-year-old Glenbrook South High School student, was fatally shot in unincorporated Glenview as detectives search for her killer.

item.title: US reopens embassy in Caracas, citing progress after Maduro extraction
item.summary: The U.S. Embassy in Caracas has formally resumed operations for the first time since 2019, a key milestone in Trump's three-phase plan for Venezuela.
